_comment: LEVEL 4 (component, frontend): notification bell — unread badge (polled), dropdown inbox, mark-read / mark-all-read. Pairs with the backend feature-notifications template. Composes comp-http-client. Uses [[ ]] delimiters.
name: comp-notification-bell
description: Notification bell: unread badge (polled), dropdown inbox, mark-read / mark-all-read. Pairs feature-notifications.
notes: Usage: <NotificationBell basePath='/api/notifications' /> — place in the Layout header (headerRight slot). Polls the unread count every 30s (pollMs prop). Backend contract: GET /api/notifications/unread-count -> {unread}, GET /api/notifications?page=&page_size= -> {items,total,page,page_size,unread}, POST /{id}/read, POST /read-all (see feature-notifications). Requires auth (Bearer token from comp-login's useAuth).
